suites.title: Export Studio — fixture harness, real files

specs.title: H3B.1: reused Mind Elixir instance reports A(11) → B(57) → A(11) and exports B's real content
PNG: full-scope export produces a valid, decodable, non-trivial PNG file
JPEG: full-scope export is a valid decodable JPEG whose background is actually opaque white, not left transparent/black
SVG: full-scope export is valid, well-formed XML with a non-zero viewBox and no NaN/Infinity coordinates
PR C1: WebP full-scope export has real RIFF/WEBP magic bytes and decodes in Chromium
PR C1: PDF create-new export still works end to end (pipeline unchanged by format gating)
Section 7 gate: the exact representative Vietnamese character set renders correctly in real SVG (XML text)
Section 7 gate: the exact representative Vietnamese character set does not corrupt a real decodable PNG
appearance: 'Trình bày' preset (legend + branding + monochrome/custom-palette color) actually changes the exported SVG markup
appearance: font change (serif) and spacing change (compact) do not corrupt the exported SVG geometry
SVG: branch-only scope includes the selected branch's label and excludes an unselected branch's label
SVG: multi-branch (selected_branches) export composes two disjoint branches, excluding a third
selected siblings keep their parent as context, exclude the third sibling, and report exact counts
PNG selected siblings are cropped substantially tighter than the full map
PR B: current_branch SVG export keeps the minimal ancestor path as context, never a sibling
closing Export Studio after a multi-branch selection leaves the live canvas viewport and map A/B state unchanged
regression: selection-bar buttons are not hijacked by the canvas's background-pan pointer capture
Section 8 artifact quality gate: full-map.png is retained and valid
Section 8 artifact quality gate: selected-branch.jpeg is retained and valid
Section 8 artifact quality gate: multi-branch.svg is retained and valid

suites.title: Export Selection Mode — checkbox pointer regression (hotfix)

specs.title: A: a real click on the checkbox itself toggles selection 0 -> 1 -> 0, opens no node-detail drawer, and leaves the canvas transform untouched
B: two real checkbox clicks on different branches both register, and 'Xóa chọn' returns count to 0
C: checking a parent and child preserves both exact IDs without unchecked siblings
D: leaving selection mode (Tiếp tục or Hủy) removes every injected checkbox from the canvas — no orphaned, still-clickable UI left behind
E: selection mode leaves <me-epd> expand/collapse and background pan fully intact
deep mixed-side selected branches keep every connector in DOM geometry and raster pixels through suppress/restore
